title: Contraception, assisted reproduction and reproductive health
source_evidence: Complete L48through33:14, L49through23:31 andL50through28:03 captions, all50assigned spans and bounded handoff read. coverage_topics.disposition: Teach method categories by site and mechanism: ovulation, sperm transport/function, cervical access, reproductive ducts. Keep ongoing contraception, emergency contraception and abortion as distinct intents/times.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach fertility awareness as cycle-observation-dependent and vulnerable to timing variability. Caption's “first 7–10 days safe” is not an invariant. State failure-rate denominator and typical versus correct use if numbers appear.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach condoms/diaphragms as physical barriers with differing STI protection. Native f0010 supports the barrier slide; spoken silicone/toxic-metal/cancer link is unsupported by that graphic and should be omitted absent material-specific evidence.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach spermicide as a local chemical method with formulation-dependent irritation and limited stand-alone effectiveness; avoid blanket toxicity or STI-protection promises.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach depot medroxyprogesterone as an injectable progestin method: ovulation suppression and delayed return of fertility can occur. Native f0014 actually says “sterility”; do not equate delay with permanent sterility. No regimen/dose.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach hormonal ring's absorption and endocrine effects; product schedules differ. Remove the mechanical fiction that it must be taken out to let blood escape. No individualized schedule.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach routine oral pills separately from levonorgestrel emergency contraception. Native f0022 blends them and shows “100%”/implantation claims. Avoid fixed age-35 cutoff, universal 100% efficacy, and unstratified metabolic/cancer claims; use eligibility and endpoint context.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach copper IUD as a copper-ion/sperm-function and fertilization mechanism, with emergency use as a separate indication. Native f0027 depicts endometrial inflammation/implantation and caption adds cancer; do not promote either as the main established mechanism or a universal cancer risk.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach tubal sterilization as interrupting sperm–oocyte meeting, not removal of ovaries or guaranteed failure-free outcome; distinguish surgical techniques.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach why male contraceptive development targets sperm production/transport; distinguish available condoms/vasectomy from experimental endocrine and duct approaches.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach external/internal condom barrier concepts and STI reduction, with correct use versus typical use distinguished; no universal complete protection.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Native f0038 lists testosterone dose and nifedipine as male contraception. Treat endocrine suppression, danazol and calcium-channel blockade as historical/research examples, not routine approved methods, and remove dose instruction.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach vasectomy as vas-duct occlusion, leaving testicular sperm production and testosterone physiology intact. Native f0043/caption call it 100% and immediate; require postprocedure semen-clearance boundary.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach polymer/vas-occlusive research separately from no-scalpel vasectomy, which is an access technique. “100%” and reversibility are product/trial dependent, not established general performance.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Explicit transition: contraception prevents pregnancy; abortion terminates an established pregnancy. Do not describe routine contraception as a way to terminate pregnancy weeks later.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Caption/native f0048 present India's MTP legal framework. Retain as a dated India example only, check operative statute/rules and categories before publication, and omit simplified universal permissions or self-directed guidance.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach medication abortion mechanism and clinician-managed gestational/context boundaries at a conceptual level. Native f0051 shows a ≤70-day/94–98% slide, while caption at 27:26 asserts nothing chemical works beyond 10–12 weeks; the latter contradicts WHO ≥12-week guidance. No drugs/doses/protocol.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach surgical abortion as a different class with gestation-dependent procedures, safety and legal setting; native f0056 is graphic D&E illustration, not a procedural tutorial or evidence of outcomes. A non-graphic diagram suffices.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach IVF as in-vitro gamete fertilization followed by embryo culture/transfer. Native f0061 says ordinary fertilization is in the uterus; correct to usual tubal ampulla. Historical priority names/dates need archival checking or omission.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach stimulation → retrieval → sperm preparation → insemination/ICSI as appropriate → culture → transfer, with implantation and live birth separate downstream events. Native f0063/f0065 protocol slides and captions mix fertilized-egg, transfer, pregnancy and “70–80% success” denominators; do not give that number as a live-birth probability. Donor gametes are possible, not required. Late L48 caption-only exercise at 32:14 asks “name one pregnancy,” one emergency method and one IVF challenge; first wording is ambiguous, likely a caption slip, so reframe explicitly rather than inventing the visible prompt.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach ED as a symptom involving vascular, neural, endocrine and psychosocial pathways. Caption reverses some risk/effect arrows; distinguish vacuum devices from implants.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach BPH as benign transition-zone growth producing possible urethral resistance, not prostate cancer. Native f0012 shows walnut→golf-ball→tennis-ball age chart; reject as a universal age-size trajectory.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach inflammatory/infectious and other prostatitis categories, without equating PSA elevation to cancer or one antibiotic course to all cases.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach neoplastic prostate tissue, local invasion and metastasis as distinct from BPH/prostatitis. Native f0018 is a stylized staging schematic; don't infer actual patient stage from drawing. Screening is separate from diagnosis.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach epididymal inflammation and possible infectious/noninfectious causes, anatomy-specific versus prostate/testis lesions; native f0024 identifies the epididymal region.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach gradual and variable age-related androgen changes; “andropause” is not a universal abrupt male menopause. Separate symptoms, measured deficiency, fertility and treatment.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach STI transmission prevention and screening as pathogen/site/exposure dependent; condoms reduce risk, not abolish all skin-contact transmission.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach *Chlamydia trachomatis* as often asymptomatic with urethral/reproductive consequences; no symptom-only diagnosis or generic regimen.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach *N. gonorrhoeae* infection and resistance as public-health concerns; treatment recommendations change, so cite current jurisdictional guideline rather than lecture drug claims.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach syphilis as *T. pallidum* with stage-dependent manifestations/latency; native f0034 is slide illustration, not a diagnostic image. Avoid assuming an ulcer is present at every stage.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach HPV type/site distinctions and vaccine prevention; not all HPV infections cause cancer, and vaccine is prevention rather than treatment of an existing lesion.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach HSV latency/reactivation and suppressive antiviral concept; caption's “no virus can be treated” is false if interpreted as symptom/replication management. Do not imply eradication.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach HIV infection versus AIDS clinical syndrome and suppressive ART concept; distinguish treatment from cure and from prevention.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach male-factor infertility through semen, endocrine, ductal and genetic possibilities. Native f0042 shows a one-third attribution claim without population/denominator. Caption suggesting testosterone therapy conflicts with spermatogenic suppression; do not suggest it as generic fertility treatment.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Late activity visibly confirmed in f0047: prostate cancer risk factors/prevention and current screening recommendations. Turn into an evidence-comparison exercise with country, date, eligibility, harms, screening versus diagnostic PSA and no personal directive.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach PMS as recurrent luteal-phase symptoms with interindividual variation; avoid treating all menstrual symptoms as the same syndrome.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach primary/secondary dysmenorrhea and prostaglandin-linked uterine contractions; severe symptoms can have structural causes. No one-size therapy.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach amenorrhea as absence of expected bleeding with pregnancy, developmental, hypothalamic, ovarian, endocrine and outflow differentials; thresholds depend on age/history.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach abnormal uterine bleeding as a pattern with structural and nonstructural causes; native f0022 is a classification slide, not evidence that a given cause is present.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach endometriosis as endometrium-like tissue outside the uterine cavity and chronic inflammatory/pain/fertility consequences. Native f0027 is a schematic; do not require laparoscopy for every clinical diagnosis.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach PCOS as ovulatory, androgenic and metabolic syndrome with diagnostic criteria and exclusion of mimics; “cysts” are neither necessary nor enough in adults, and adolescent rules differ.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach leiomyomas by myometrial origin and location-dependent bleeding/pressure/fertility effects; prevalence and symptoms are not interchangeable.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach PID as upper genital-tract inflammation, frequently related to ascending STI pathogens; native f0034 identifies reproductive compartments. Do not equate it with UTI or infer pathogen from appearance.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach pelvic support, prolapse compartments and symptom variability. Native f0041 stage chart is schematic, not population prevalence proof; source's 50–60% needs definition/cohort before use.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Distinguish pelvic-floor muscle training, a pessary device, native-tissue repair and mesh route/material. Native f0043 annotates support anatomy; caption confuses Kegels with pessaries. Spider-silk material is a research concept, not established clinical standard. U.S. transvaginal POP mesh market withdrawal must not be generalized to all abdominal mesh procedures.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach cervical cancer's high-risk HPV relationship and distinguish prevention (vaccination), screening, diagnostic follow-up and treatment. Native f0046 site sketch cannot establish a lesion or stage.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach endometrial versus other uterine cancers and symptom/risk context. Native f0050 labels a uterine site; avoid implying one therapy covers all histologies.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach ovarian/tubal/peritoneal epithelial malignancies with histologic/site distinction; source's “most common female cancer” is false as a general ranking. CA-125 can inform selected diagnostic/monitoring contexts; do not offer it as a general population screening test.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach menopause as retrospective cessation of menses from ovarian follicle decline, with variable timing and symptoms. Native f0053/caption's 40–45 age interval is too narrow/early as a general population statement. Do not conflate menopause hormone therapy with contraception.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Teach vaginal microbial ecology as a dynamic association with estrogen, pH, life stage and infection risk; native f0056 is a generic slide, not species or causal microscopy. Reject caption's fixed “only 3–4 drugs” resistant-infection claim without pathogen/date/context. Late L50 caption-only question at 27:36 asks for an emerging uterine-prolapse intervention: answer as a research-evidence comparison, not as patient recommendation.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not acceptance
